newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU reports 15 percent profit rise in 199.
newsitem.headline: VNU reports 15 percent profit rise in 199.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Tuesday its 1996 ordinary net profit and ordinary earnings per share would show a rise of about 15 percent compared with 1995.

All of the group's subsidiaries had shown better results, with consumer magazines in various countries and business information activities in the U.S. and Europe outperforming in particular, VNU said in a statement.
It repeated its earlier prediction that minority-owned interests in Dutch and Belgian commercial television stations brought in substantially lower results than in 1995.

VNU said in August it expected 1996 full-year profit growth to at least match the 13 percent rise posted in the first half of the year. In 1995, VNU's net from ordinary operations rose by 26 percent to 274 million guilders.
